# DAFO Swarm

> DAFO Swarm runs large language models on a company's own machines and serves them through an OpenAI-compatible HTTP API on port 43100 of the coordinator, with agents, a knowledge base, files, MCP tools and built-in tools. Documentation describes version 0.1.0-20261015.1.

To integrate DAFO Swarm into an app, read the single self-contained AI integration file first; the other documents are the full human-oriented reference.

## AI integration

- [AI integration file](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gabgiani/dafo-swarm-downloads/main/llms-full.txt): what it enables, key concepts, connection, rules for AI assistants, recipes in Python, TypeScript and curl, request shapes, errors, limits, security, DAFO SAP Connect integration, endpoint index

## Docs

- [HTTP API reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gabgiani/dafo-swarm-downloads/main/docs/API.md): every endpoint with request and response examples
- [Agents that work together](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gabgiani/dafo-swarm-downloads/main/docs/AGENTS.md): subagents, modes, the conversation workspace and team design

## Examples

- [Examples overview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gabgiani/dafo-swarm-downloads/main/examples/README.md): runnable curl, Python and JavaScript clients

## Optional

- [Downloads and installation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gabgiani/dafo-swarm-downloads/main/README.md): installers, checksums, first steps, Office add-ins
- [DAFO SAP Connect AI integration file](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gabgiani/dafo-sap-connect-downloads/main/llms-full.txt): SAP Business One data as read-only MCP tools that DAFO Swarm can call
